trailhead.label: Village square (Dorfplatz) in Lajen, the board’s start

waypoints.label: Village fountain on the square in Lajen (seasonal)

cautions: A short steep stretch up to the Wetterkreuz.
About 400 m on village lanes at the start (Wasserbühl-Weg, Kasserol-Weg), shared with local traffic.
The Wasserbühel is a protected biotope: stay on the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
